review_method: Contact sheets and individual PNG inspection of every assigned PDF page, including reference page 80. After the final layout correction, physical pages 33 and 34 were inspected again at full page size.

checks.figures: Figures 7 to 13 show separated titles, subtitles, plot labels and captions. Matrices, graphs, colour scales and plotted curves are readable. No clipping or malformed graphic found.
checks.mathematics: Displayed matrices, fractions, subscripts, sums, norms and boxed formulas render correctly in the reviewed pages. No mathematical overlap found.
checks.tables: Tables on PDF pages 49 and 50 remain within the text margins. Columns, rows and captions are separated.
checks.code: Algorithm listings split across PDF pages 51 and 52 without code or footer clipping.
checks.headings: Section and subsection headings have following content. No isolated heading found.
checks.footer: Footers and page numbers remain separated from body content.
checks.references: Reference page 80 contains nine readable bibliography items. Selected pages contain no unresolved-reference placeholders or replacement glyphs.

resolved_issues.description: A solitary QED square at the top right of PDF page 34 belongs to theorem 8.9 proof, whose final display is at the bottom of page 33. The proof text is intact, but its end marker is orphaned onto the following page.
resolved_issues.requested_resolution: Adjust layout outside the frozen proof body so the QED marker stays with its proof on PDF page 33.
resolved_issues.resolution: Local page enlargement outside the proof moves the QED square to the bottom right of physical PDF page 33, above and separate from the footer. Physical page 34 now begins with its explanatory callout. Both full page images were inspected after the final rebuild.
